CREATE FUNCTION Clientcsfn__FeatureRequestVotingResult ( @CampaignPK uniqueidentifier ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN SELECT HY_PK, TotalVoteCount, TotalVotedEBV + ISNULL(ParentFRValue.T9_EBV, 0) + SUM(ISNULL(RelatedFRValue.T9_EBV, 0)) AS TotalEBV, TotalVotedContribution + ISNULL(ParentFRValue.T9_Contribution, 0) + SUM(ISNULL(RelatedFRValue.T9_Contribution, 0)) AS TotalContribution FROM ( SELECT HY_PK, HY_ReferenceID, COUNT(HZ_PK) AS TotalVoteCount, SUM(ISNULL(T9_EBV, 0)) AS TotalVotedEBV, SUM(ISNULL(T9_Contribution, 0)) AS TotalVotedContribution FROM VoteExamSurveyQuestion WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN VoteExamSurveyAnswer WITH (NOLOCK) ON HZ_HY = HY_PK LEFT JOIN ClientFeatureRequestValueAndContribution WITH (NOLOCK) ON T9_ParentID = HZ_PK WHERE HY_G0 = @CampaignPK AND HY_AnswerType = 'VTM' GROUP BY HY_PK, HY_ReferenceID ) AS VotingResults LEFT JOIN IncidentMain ParentIncident with (nolock) ON ParentIncident.IM_PK = HY_ReferenceID LEFT JOIN IncidentLink with (nolock) ON IK_ParentID = ParentIncident.IM_PK AND IK_LinkType = 'FRF' LEFT JOIN IncidentMain RelatedIncident with (nolock) ON RelatedIncident.IM_PK = IK_IM LEFT JOIN ClientFeatureRequestValueAndContribution ParentFRValue WITH (NOLOCK) ON ParentFRValue.T9_ParentID = ParentIncident.IM_PK LEFT JOIN ClientFeatureRequestValueAndContribution RelatedFRValue WITH (NOLOCK) ON RelatedFRValue.T9_ParentID = RelatedIncident.IM_PK GROUP BY HY_PK, ParentIncident.IM_PK, TotalVoteCount, TotalVotedEBV, TotalVotedContribution, ParentFRValue.T9_EBV, ParentFRValue.T9_Contribution

CREATE FUNCTION ClientReport_CustomerServiceStaffActivity(@LowerBoundDate datetime, @UpperBoundDate datetime, @Product char(3)) RETURNS @result TABLE ( GS_FullName nvarchar(100), GS_Code char(3), Taken int, TakenFromBacklog int, TakenOnSteQueue int, Total int ) AS BEGIN SET @LowerBoundDate = ISNULL(@LowerBoundDate, DATEADD(dd, 0, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, GETDATE()))) SET @UpperBoundDate = ISNULL(@UpperBoundDate, DATEADD(dd, 1, @LowerBoundDate))
INSERT INTO @result SELECT *, Taken + TakenFromBacklog + TakenOnSteQueue AS Total FROM ( SELECT GS_FullName, GS_Code, SUM( CASE WHEN IM_SystemCreateTimeUtc >= @LowerBoundDate AND IM_SystemCreateTimeUtc < @UpperBoundDate AND IM_OrderReceived >= @LowerBoundDate AND IM_OrderReceived < @UpperBoundDate AND IM_ResolutionCode != 'STE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Taken, SUM( CASE WHEN IM_SystemCreateTimeUtc < @LowerBoundDate AND IM_OrderReceived >= @LowerBoundDate AND IM_OrderReceived < @UpperBoundDate AND IM_ResolutionCode != 'STE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TakenFromBacklog, SUM( CASE WHEN IM_SystemCreateTimeUtc >= @LowerBoundDate AND IM_SystemCreateTimeUtc < @UpperBoundDate AND IM_OrderReceived >= @LowerBoundDate AND IM_OrderReceived < @UpperBoundDate AND IM_ResolutionCode = 'STE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS TakenOnSteQueue
FROM IncidentMain (NOLOCK) INNER JOIN GlbStaff (NOLOCK) on GS_PK = IM_GS_CustomerServiceContact
WHERE IM_IncidentType = 'INC' AND (@Product IS NULL OR @Product = '' OR IM_Product = @Product)
GROUP BY GS_Code, GS_FullName ) ReportData WHERE Taken + TakenFromBacklog + TakenOnSteQueue > 0
RETURN
END;
